verdict.rationale: LocalAI ships no client libraries of its own in the evidence. Its docs say it exposes an OpenAI-compatible API (plus Anthropic Messages API compatibility), so developers can call it from existing OpenAI or Claude SDKs by pointing them at localhost:8080. That covers the practical need through other vendors' libraries rather than official LocalAI ones. Missing for 10: first-party LocalAI client libraries, language-specific Python/JavaScript usage docs or examples, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the SDKs work against the server.
